notes: DEFECT TAXONOMY (the work order's reporting rule — every defect with reproduction, root-cause class, fix, pin): D1 responsive scroll-trap (console; .app-shell items min-width:auto) -> min-width:0 + table display:block/overflow-x:auto, pinned. D2 aria-describedby on the label (console) -> injected on the control, pinned. D3 unstyled field errors + never-rendered idempotency error (console) -> .field-error + role=alert + errorOf(), pinned. D4 class='card form' carrying no rule (console) -> class='flow card', pinned. D5 credentials form hints unwired (console) -> aria-describedby wiring, pinned. D6 unstyled secret reveal (console) -> section.reveal/.secret-reveal rules, pinned. D7 ol.steps reusing the timeline two-column grid (console) -> ol.steps grid rule + markup switch, pinned. D8 command-suggestions 'mangle' (harness/display-pipeline PHANTOM — the environment strips the byte sequence '[h' from displayed output; od -c + git blob comparison proved the bytes well-formed) -> pinned byte-exactly, no code change. D9 unstyled .form-label (console) -> font-weight 600, pinned. D10 run-detail mobile scroll-trap (console — found by THIS tail turn's drive): .detail-grid's bare 1fr auto-minimum track sized to the artifacts table's ~392px min-content at the 351px mobile content width -> 404px document scrollWidth at 375px; fixed with minmax(0,1fr) on the base and <=1024px tracks (the >=1025px rule already had it); re-driven clean; pinned (2 tests, fail-before on base). D11 Compare action links 69x18 below the WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 24x24 minimum (console — found by the drive) -> a.row-action (inline-block, min 24x24, token padding) on both call sites; re-driven 85x32; pinned (3 tests, fail-before on base). Root-cause classes: ALL eleven are console-class except D8 (harness/display-pipeline). No Zeck-core, provider or access defects surfaced.
